prompts.baita:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit image 1, the character's new combat sprite. Image 2 is Wu's existing combat sprite, whose SCREEN-RIGHT facing orientation is the target. Correct the pose and gaze: the ENTIRE character unequivocally faces to SCREEN RIGHT, with right-facing head and facial profile, nose pointing right, eyes looking at an opponent off-screen to the RIGHT, torso and shoulders rotated right, hips rotated right, boots/toes pointing right. Show a readable right-facing three-quarter SIDE VIEW, approximately 65-75 degrees away from front view. Do NOT look at the viewer, do NOT merely shift eyes while body remains front-facing. The battle opponent is to the right, never in front of the viewer. Preserve same character face identity, hair, costume, colours, height, body proportions, props and simplified hard-edge anime paint treatment. Redraw the pose naturally rather than mirror the original front view. Landscape 1536x1024, one full-body character only, entire silhouette/weapon/hair visible with generous padding, ground baseline at 91% height, occupy about 78% height. Output truly transparent background, alpha=0 everywhere outside character/props, hard clean silhouette with natural antialiased edges. Remove all blurry brown/grey backdrop, any haze, halo, vignette, smoke, floor shadow. No text, labels, scenery, frame, grid, camera-facing gaze, frontal shoulders or front-facing stance.
Role-specific orientation: Keep her seated, but rotate the entire seated woman AND her wooden chair so both face screen-right. Chair back behind her on SCREEN LEFT. Her knees, skirt, feet, book on lap and hands point toward screen-right. Head in right-facing profile, green eye looks right toward opponent. Keep ancient book on lap and two floating books beside shoulders; calm ready-to-cast hands. Preserve green suspender dress and white blouse.
